title: Marvin voice latency line
description: One JSON object per answered turn, one per line (JSON Lines), written by the Java host and read by ./marvin report (Marvin v1 contract C6, frozen 2026-10-14; docs/voice.md, Latency). Times are milliseconds from the end of the person's speech; a stage that did not happen is null. New stages may be added as extra *_ms numbers; the required ones never change meaning.

t.description: Wall-clock time of the end of speech, seconds since the Unix epoch.

lang.description: The language of the answer, ISO 639-1 (fr, en, ...).

stt_ms.description: End of speech to the transcript (speech recognition, what was left to wait for).

llm_first_token_ms.description: End of speech to the model's first token of the answer.

tts_first_audio_ms.description: End of speech to the first synthesised audio of the first clause.

robot_out_ms.description: End of speech to the first audio played by the robot's speaker; null when the voice speaks on the computer.

total_ms.description: End of speech to the first audio heard, wherever it plays (the app's 'first word').
